description: Work out UK student loan repayments from an annual salary using 2026/27 thresholds. Plans: 'p1' Plan 1 (9% above £26,900), 'p2' Plan 2 (9% above £29,385), 'p4' Plan 4 (9% above £33,795), 'p5' Plan 5 (9% above £25,000), 'pg' Postgraduate Loan (6% above £21,000). An undergraduate plan can optionally add a Postgraduate Loan on top. Returns yearly and monthly repayments. Amounts in GBP. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/student-loan-calculator/

addPostgraduate.description: Add a Postgraduate Loan on top of an undergraduate plan (ignored when plan is pg; default false)
